Name: Pâtisserie Sadaharu Aoki Paris
Hours: Shop 11:00–20:00; salon 11:00–17:30 (last order 17:00); irregular closures
Address (JA): 東京都千代田区丸の内3-4-1 新国際ビル1F
Notes: The benchmark for Japanese-French crossover pastry. Order the matcha éclair, matcha mille-feuille, black sesame macarons or the "Bamboo" matcha opera, to take away or in the salon.

Name: Pâtisserie ease
Hours: 11:00–18:00 (eat-in last order 17:00); closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋兜町9-1
Notes: A France-trained chef pairs Japanese herbs with fruit, as in the shiso-mango mousse. Sit at the seven-seat counter for plated desserts, or take cakes away. Three minutes from Kayabacho Station.

Name: Pâtisserie Asako Iwayanagi
Hours: 11:00–18:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区等々力4-4-5
Notes: Famous for parfaits of up to 20 components (kinako gelato, green-tea mochi) plus a petits gâteaux case. Parfaits usually need a reservation.

Name: Pâtisserie Ryoura
Hours: 12:00–17:00; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays plus irregular closures
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区用賀4-29-5 グリーンヒルズ用賀ST 1F
Notes: A critically loved neighborhood shop making classic French cakes with seasonal Japanese fruit. Worth the suburban trip.

Name: 365日
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区富ヶ谷1-2-8
Notes: An influential bakery built on domestic ingredients: try the matcha-citrus brioche and the kinako cream buns. A minute or two from Yoyogi-Hachiman Station; pair it with a Tomigaya coffee.

Name: BOUL'ANGE
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区道玄坂1-12-1 渋谷マークシティ 1F
Notes: Easy croissant stop: yuzu croissants plus seasonal sakura and chestnut editions.

Name: KURAMAE CANNELE
Hours: 11:00–18:00; closed Mondays
Address (JA): 東京都台東区蔵前2-1-23 K2B 蔵前第二ビル 1F
Notes: A canelé specialist, with takeout on the ground floor and a café upstairs. Combine it with Dandelion Chocolate Kuramae and its local green-tea-scented hot chocolate.

Name: Mont St. Clair
Hours: 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesdays plus occasional extra days; salon last order 16:00; salon closed 1 Dec 2026 to spring 2027
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区自由が丘2-22-4
Notes: Hironobu Tsujiguchi's flagship, with a huge pastry case and a 16-seat salon. Jiyugaoka is a sweets district, good for a half day.

Name: Pâtisserie Asterisque
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区大山町
Notes: Chef Koichi Izumi, trained in France, has run this classically French shop on Inokashira-dori since 2012. Order the mille-feuille, the Mont Blanc or a fruit entremets. Takeaway only.

Name: Am Stram Gram
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区恵比寿南一丁目
Notes: A tart specialist with 20-plus varieties a day, topped with fruit from local farms.

Name: Okashiya Ucchi
Hours: Eat-in 13:00–16:00, by reservation
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区千駄ヶ谷3-27-9
Notes: A tiny shop among Tabelog's top-rated Tokyo cake shops (4.19). Owner Yusuke Uchiyama makes just the day's batch, and it sells out. Take cakes away, or book the eat-in space at the back (four groups a day); look for おかしやうっちー, four minutes' walk from Kita-Sando Station.

Name: Naniwaya Sohonten
Hours: 11:00–19:00; closed Tuesdays and the 3rd Wednesday
Address (JA): 東京都港区麻布十番1-8-14
Notes: Claims to have invented taiyaki (Meiji era); Hokkaido azuki simmered 8 hours. One of Tokyo's big three.

Name: Yanagiya
Hours: 12:30–18:00 or until sold out; closed Sundays and public holidays
Address (JA): 東京都中央区日本橋人形町2-11-3
Notes: Since 1916; anko made by hand each morning; sells out daily. One of Tokyo's big three.

Name: Taiyaki Wakaba
Address (JA): ~東京都新宿区若葉一丁目
Notes: One of Tokyo's big three taiyaki shops, grilling since 1953, with slightly salty anko packed right to the tail. Cash only.

Name: Nezu no Taiyaki
Hours: From 10:00 until sold out (usually 12:30–14:00); closed weekends and public holidays
Address (JA): 東京都文京区根津1-23-9-104
Notes: Family-run since the 1950s, baking each taiyaki in its own iron mold (tennen) for a thin, crisp shell. Go early: it often sells out by midday. Takeout only, and cash only.

Name: Taiyaki Sharaku
Address (JA): ~東京都台東区浅草三丁目
Notes: Tennen-style single-mold taiyaki, classic red bean. Convenient during Asakusa sightseeing.

Name: Himitsudo
Hours: 10:00–19:00 (Sat/Sun from 09:00), varying by season; closed Mondays, plus Tuesdays from October to June
Address (JA): 東京都台東区谷中3-11-18
Notes: Tokyo's most famous kakigori shop: fluffy ice shaved from natural ice, with house-made seasonal fruit syrups. Expect long lines, and check its X account (@himitsuno132) for the season's hours.

Name: Azuki to Kouri
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区代々木1-46-2 グランデュオ代々木1F
Notes: Kakigori of azuki and meringue with a mochi sauce, from a Florilège pastry chef. The seasonal flavors change every couple of weeks, and seats can be booked on TableCheck.

Name: Oribe
Address (JA): ~東京都世田谷区北沢二丁目
Notes: Inventive kakigori: hojicha milk, matcha with kinako warabi mochi, red bean, plus wild cards like an Indian-spiced "Namaste" ice. It's summer-only, served in the Japanese-sweets café of a tableware shop.

Name: Wa Kitchen Kanna
Hours: Daytime only
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区下馬2-43-11 2F
Notes: Kakigori all year since 2013, in Japanese-leaning flavors like "wakaba" (strawberry and matcha) plus experimental monthly specials; Japanese set meals too. Twelve minutes' walk from Sangenjaya Station's south exit, on Chazawa-dori near Setagaya Park.

Name: Sabo Okuno Shibuya
Hours: 11:00–18:30 (last order); closed Tuesdays
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神山町7-15 ホワイトハイム大嵩102
Notes: Experimental kakigori: coffee and hazelnut cream with coffee warabi mochi, or even a savory avocado-salad ice. Seats go by numbered ticket, taken on the day or online. Look for 茶房 オクノシブヤ, ten minutes' walk from Shibuya Station.

Name: Asakusa Naniwaya
Address (JA): ~東京都台東区雷門二丁目
Notes: Naniwaya Sohonten's Asakusa branch, since 2010: taiyaki, plus cloud-soft kakigori all year in ten or so flavors, with seasonal fruit and slow-simmered sauces (add the sweet potato sauce). Eat in at its tea room, two minutes from Asakusa Station on the Tsukuba Express. Handy for Asakusa days.

Name: VIGO
Hours: Weekdays 13:00-23:00; Sat, Sun, holidays 11:00-23:00 (last order 22:15)
Address (JA): 東京都台東区蔵前4-21-2 FOCUS KURAMAE 1F
Notes: A night-parfait specialist in a hostel's ground-floor lounge, five minutes' walk from Kuramae Station. Three seasonal parfaits, with Uji matcha, yuzu sorbet, anko and salted kinako sable. One drink order is required per parfait.

Name: Parfaiteria beL
Hours: Mon–Thu 17:00–24:00; Fri and eve of holidays 17:00–01:00; Sat 15:00–01:00; Sun and holidays 15:00–24:00; no regular closing day; last order 30 min before close
Address (JA): 東京都新宿区新宿3-8-2 クロスビル4F
Notes: From Sapporo's late-night "shime parfait" scene; artful parfaits with items like kuromame (black soybeans), burdock chips, tofu shiratama, Kaga bocha (roasted tea) jelly. Café-bar.

Name: Melon and Roman
Hours: 11:30–17:30 Wed–Sun; closed Mon and Tue (open if a holiday); café last order 16:30; closed year-end/New Year
Address (JA): 東京都新宿区神楽坂3-6-92
Notes: Melon specialist; Japanese muskmelon parfait with lemon granita. A take on Japan's fruit-parlor culture.

Name: Mr. CHEESECAKE
Hours: 8:00–22:00 Mon–Sat; 8:00–21:00 Sun and holidays; no regular closing day; takeout only
Address (JA): 東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 JR東京駅構内 B1F グランスタ東京 銀の鈴エリア
Notes: Cult brand's only permanent shop; France-trained chef; texture goes from rare (unbaked) to baked; seasonal flavors like maple pumpkin.

Name: CinqCinq
Address (JA): 東京都港区麻布十番2-4-8 麻布十番館 1F
Notes: Order the ten-flavor cheesecake sampler, made with Hokkaido dairy: yuzu, sakura and dekopon (a Japanese citrus) are among the flavors.

Name: Johann
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区上目黒1-18-15
Notes: Simple, mellow cheesecake made to the same natural-ingredient recipe since 1978. Takeout only, by the Meguro River, a three- or four-minute walk from Nakameguro Station (not Meguro Station).

Name: Shirotae
Hours: Tue–Fri 10:30–19:30; Sat 10:30–19:00; closed Sun and Mon
Address (JA): 東京都港区赤坂4-1-4
Notes: An old-school shop known for small, intense rare cheesecakes topped with pistachio, and for its cream puffs. Cream puffs can be reserved up to the day before.

Name: Pâtisserie TEN&
Hours: Takeaway 12:00–16:00 and 17:30–20:00; dine-in 12:00–15:30 and 17:30–19:30; open year-round
Address (JA): 東京都千代田区内幸町1-7-1 HIBIYA OKUROJI
Notes: A choux specialist: crisp shells filled with Uji matcha cream, among other flavors. Older guides list it as Pâtisserie PAROLA, its name until April 2024.

Name: Le Coussinet
Hours: Fri–Sun only
Address (JA): 東京都文京区根津2-34-24
Notes: Stone-oven cream puffs, filled on the spot.

Name: Shirohige's Cream Puff Workshop
Hours: 10:30–18:00; closed Tuesdays (Wednesday if Tuesday is a holiday)
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区代田5-3-1 1F
Notes: Officially licensed Totoro-shaped cream puffs with seasonal fillings. The café upstairs, Toro Coffee & Bakery, is a separate business.

Name: I'm donut ?
Hours: 9:00–19:00 or until sold out; irregular closing days
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区上目黒1-22-10
Notes: Ultra-soft, brioche-like "nama" donuts from the team behind Amam Dacotan. This is the original of its several branches: a takeout-only shop under the elevated tracks by Nakameguro Station's east exit.

Name: haritts
Hours: Mon–Fri 10:00–16:00; Sat and holidays 11:30–16:00; closed Sundays
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区上原1-34-2
Notes: Soft, bread-like donuts in a homey café. Highly rated: 3.79 on Tabelog.

Name: Suzukien x Nanaya
Hours: 11:00–17:00; irregular closing days
Address (JA): 東京都台東区浅草3-4-3
Notes: Tea merchant Suzukien's shop, scooping matcha gelato in seven intensities up to "Premium No. 7", made by Nanaya of Fujieda, Shizuoka. Hojicha and genmaicha too.

Name: Japanese Ice Ouca
Hours: 11:00–23:00 daily (no fixed closing day); last order 23:00
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区恵比寿1-6-7 animo ebisu 1F
Notes: Japanese-style ice cream in seasonal flavors like chestnut and sweet potato, topped with salted kombu.

Name: Maison Farmer Nagisa Aoki
Hours: 12:00–20:00; closed Wednesdays plus irregular closures
Address (JA): 東京都目黒区鷹番3-15-18 ル・コントゥ学芸大学102
Notes: Ice cream in ingredient-led flavors from Japanese producers: fig leaf, hassaku citrus, sansho pepper milk. It moved here from Sangenjaya. Check its Instagram for irregular closures before you go.

Name: Kasiki
Address (JA): ~東京都渋谷区西原一丁目
Notes: Creative pairings like rhubarb with sansho pepper and green tea with rosemary.

Name: Tida
Address (JA): ~東京都杉並区高円寺南四丁目
Notes: Gelato in Okinawan flavors: purple sweet potato, kokuto (black sugar) chocolate and Okinawan fruit.

Name: Chavaty
Hours: 10:00–20:00 daily; closed Jan 1
Address (JA): 東京都渋谷区神宮前4-6-9 南原宿ビル 1F
Notes: The flagship of tea specialist Chavaty, near Harajuku. Its hojicha soft serve is made with teas from different prefectures.

Name: Asakusa Chaya Tabane no Shi
Address (JA): ~東京都台東区浅草二丁目
Notes: Premium matcha crepe specialist using Shizuoka (Kakegawa) matcha. Also has a Kyoto branch on Shinkyogoku.

Name: Juseian
Hours: 11:00–17:30 (to 17:00 in winter); closes when sold out; irregular holidays
Address (JA): 東京都台東区浅草2-7-21
Notes: Chewy matcha crepes made with Uji matcha, near Hanayashiki.

Name: Natural Crepe
Address (JA): 東京都世田谷区経堂1-25-17 ルート経堂ビル
Notes: The original shop of Natural Crepe, a chain of ten or so, with seats to eat in. The batter is domestic wheat and wheat germ, and the anko and sesame sauce are additive-free.

Name: Assemblages Kakimoto
Hours: Cafe 12:00–17:00 (last order), store 12:00–19:00; dinner from 18:00 by reservation only; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区竹屋町通寺町西入ル松本町587-5
Notes: An award-winning chocolatier working Japanese ingredients into chocolates and plated desserts, served at a counter salon. Dinner is by reservation only.

Name: PÂTISSERIE.S salon
Hours: 13:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; may close early if cakes sell out
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区朝倉町546 ウェルスアーリ天保1F
Notes: The eat-in café of PÂTISSERIE.S, one of Kyoto's top-ranked cake shops on Tabelog (3.82). It's near Kyoto City Hall-mae Station.

Name: PÂTISSERIE.S
Hours: 11:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; may close early if cakes sell out
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区高辻通室町西入繁昌町300-1 カノン室町四条1F
Notes: The original PÂTISSERIE.S shop (Tabelog 3.78). Cakes are takeaway only; it's a few minutes from Shijo-Karasuma.

Name: grains de vanille
Hours: Mon–Sat 10:30–18:00; closed Sundays and the 1st and 3rd Mondays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区間之町二条下ル鍵屋町486
Notes: A long-standing top French patisserie in Kyoto (Tabelog 3.78), known for refined petits gâteaux; in Japanese it's グラン ヴァニーユ. Central and easy to fit in, but check its Instagram or Facebook for closures before you go.

Name: La Voiture
Hours: Tue–Sun 11:30–18:00 (last order 17:00); closed Mondays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区聖護院円頓美町47-5
Notes: A tiny shop that has made one famous tarte tatin, from a family recipe, for decades (Tabelog 3.71). Pair it with the Okazaki museums, and come early on weekends, when the cakes sell out.

Name: Malebranche Kitayama Honten
Hours: Shop 9:00–17:30 daily; salon 10:00–17:30 (last order 17:00); no regular closing day
Address (JA): 京都府京都市北区北山通植物園北山門前
Notes: Kyoto institution behind the matcha "Cha no Ka" langue de chat; the main store has a full cake case.

Name: Le Petit Mec
Hours: 8:00–18:00 daily, no regular closing day
Address (JA): 京都府京都市上京区元北小路町159
Notes: Beloved Parisian-style bakery; go for croissants and viennoiserie.

Name: Shinshindo Kyodai Kitamonmae
Hours: 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Tuesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区北白川追分町88
Notes: A French bakery-café in business since the early 1900s, facing Kyoto University's north gate. Go for the atmosphere more than for fusion.

Name: Gion Tokuya
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-127
Notes: Kyoto's best-known warabi mochi, made from real bracken flour (honwarabi) and served on ice; at the end, pour the kuromitsu over the melting ice. Expect a line: take a queue ticket and they call your phone when it's your turn.

Name: Saryo Hosen
Hours: 10:00–17:00 (last order 16:45); closed Wednesdays and Thursdays (next weekday if a holiday)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区下鴨西高木町25
Notes: Made to order and served in a tatami room overlooking a garden, with Okinawan black sugar syrup. Eat-in only. Pair with Shimogamo Shrine.

Name: Mitsuya
Address (JA): 京都府京都市右京区西院高山寺町8
Notes: A takeout-only warabi mochi shop, opened in February 2022 right by Hankyu Saiin Station. Natural Akita bracken flour gives it extra stretch; there are six or so flavors, including azuki with cacao nibs.

Name: Ichijoji Nakaya
Hours: Shop 9:00–18:00, café 10:00–17:00 (last order); closed Wednesdays except open in late November; also closed around Obon and New Year
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区一乗寺花ノ木町5
Notes: Summer "zaru warabi" with fresh Hokkaido cream, kuromitsu and kinako (Japanese-Western mix). Also known for dechi yokan.

Name: Mamemono to Taiyaki
Hours: 10:00–17:00 daily, no fixed closing day
Address (JA): 京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺芒ノ馬場町40-8 嵐山昇龍苑1F
Notes: Round, thin-crust taiyaki with Kyoto anko or custard. Kyoto's top-rated taiyaki on Tabelog (3.51). Takeout only.

Name: Ichiwa (Ichimonjiya Wasuke)
Hours: 10:00–17:00; closed Wednesdays (open if Wednesday is the 1st/15th or a holiday, then closed next day); closed Dec 16–31 approx.
Address (JA): 京都府京都市北区紫野今宮町69
Notes: Open since about the year 1000. Thumb-sized mochi dusted in kinako, charcoal-grilled on bamboo skewers, served in white miso sauce. Daitokuji is 5 min away.

Name: Kazariya (Aburi Mochi Honke Nemoto Kazariya)
Hours: 10:00–17:00; closed Wednesdays; closed Dec 16–31
Address (JA): 京都府京都市北区紫野今宮町96
Notes: An Edo-period shop serving aburi (grilled) mochi, the same dish as its rival Ichiwa; try both.

Name: Kamo Mitarashi Chaya
Hours: 9:30–18:30 Mon, Thu–Sun; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays (Tuesday closure irregular)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区下鴨松ノ木町53
Notes: Said to be the birthplace of mitarashi dango (grilled, sweet soy glaze). Pair with Saryo Hosen.

Name: Demachi Futaba
Hours: 8:30–17:30 (Tuesdays 9:00–17:00); closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市上京区出町通今出川上ル青龍町236
Notes: Top-rated on Tabelog; famous mame daifuku (mochi with salty black soybeans). Go in the morning to beat the line.

Name: Kawabata Doki
Hours: 9:30–17:30; closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市左京区下鴨南野々神町2-12
Notes: One of Tabelog's top-rated traditional wagashi makers. Reserve your sweets ahead and take them away; there's no eating on the premises.

Name: Kyo no Koriya Sawa
Hours: Wednesday–Sunday 11:00–18:30; closed Mondays and Tuesdays (seasonal shop)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市上京区泰童片原町664-7
Notes: Known for an unusual kakigori made with Kyoto white miso. It's a seasonal shop, so check it's open for your dates.

Name: Mikazuki Hyokaten
Hours: 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区下新シ町329
Notes: Uji kintoki (matcha and azuki) with house-made milk ice cream.

Name: Gion Kinana Honten
Hours: 12:00–17:30; closed Thursdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側570-119
Notes: Kinako (roasted soybean) ice cream and kinako parfaits, at one of Kyoto's top ice cream shops (Tabelog 3.68). Cashless only; reserve by Instagram DM.

Name: Premarché Gelateria
Hours: Mon, Tue, Thu 12:00–18:00; Fri–Sun 12:00–20:00; closed Wednesdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区三条通猪熊西入御供町308
Notes: Rice-based flavors like "Mizuho no Kuni" rice gelato and roasted rice caramel; many vegan options.

Name: Tomomi Gelato
Hours: 13:00–20:00 Mon, Tue, Fri, Sun and holidays; Sat 13:00–22:00; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市下京区西橋詰町759 SAKIZO河原町五条ビル1F
Notes: Japanese produce: Setoda lemon, Gifu "Mino Musume" strawberry, salted sweet sake ("Kyohime").

Name: Hitsuji
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区大炊町
Notes: Tabelog's #1 donut shop in Japan (3.85). Chunky natural-yeast donuts with kinako, wasanbon sugar, germinated brown rice. Sells out.

Name: koé donuts kyoto
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区新京極通四条上る中之町557
Notes: Donuts made in front of you in a striking bamboo-basket interior designed by Kengo Kuma (Tabelog 3.67).

Name: DONUTSTAND Arashiyama
Address (JA): 京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺造路町20-2
Notes: Crème brûlée donuts made from soy-milk dough, in matcha and seasonal versions. The shop is inside Randen Arashiyama Station.

Name: Fromagerie Harmonie
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市左京区東門前町
Notes: Soufflé-style Japanese cheesecake in several cheeses: blue, gouda, mascarpone. Near Heian Shrine and the museums.

Name: Sanjya
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市下京区真町
Notes: A long-running crepe shop; the signature is a matcha crème brûlée crepe with wagashi touches.

Name: Petit Bonheur
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺造路町
Notes: Wazuka matcha and matcha tiramisu crepes, served with kuromitsu and warabi mochi.

Name: Goma-ya Crepe-Do
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市中京区下丸屋町
Notes: Crepes built around sesame, both sweet and savory.

Name: Année
Hours: 11:00–18:00; irregular holidays
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区姉小路通室町西入南側突抜町139 プリモフィオーレ室町101
Notes: More bakery than patisserie: fermented-butter croissants, rye bread, seasonal fruit sandos, Basque cheesecake and lunch sets. Few seats, and a line at opening. Check its Instagram for closed days before you go.

Name: Kagizen Yoshifusa
Hours: Tea room 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Mondays (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday)
Address (JA): 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側264
Notes: An Edo-period confectioner whose signature is kuzukiri (arrowroot noodles), made to order and served on ice with kuromitsu in the tea room. The Kodaiji branch makes a good backup.

Name: LIBERTÉ PÂTISSERIE BOULANGERIE Kyoto
Address (JA): 京都府京都市中京区東洞院通六角下る御射山町273 プラウド京都東洞院1F
Notes: A Paris-born bakery-patisserie with a white marble-and-tile café: AOP-butter croissants, fig cereal bread and French pastries. There's a newer branch at Kiyomizu too.

Name: Gâteau des Bois
Hours: 10:00–18:00 (eat-in 12:00–17:00); closed Thursdays
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市西大寺南町1-19-101
Notes: Nara's best-known French patisserie; café branch A Ra Maison rated 3.74. One Kintetsu stop from central Nara.

Name: Wokashi Tojo
Address (JA): ~奈良県奈良市中院町
Notes: A cake shop and café (Tabelog 3.53).

Name: Nakatanidou
Hours: 10:00–18:00; irregular closures
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市橋本町29
Notes: Famous high-speed mochi pounding out front. Get the yomogi mochi (mugwort, anko, kinako) hot.

Name: Senjuan Yoshimune
Hours: 10:00–18:00; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市押上町39-1
Notes: Warabi mochi plus creative daifuku such as kinako cream and seasonal grape.

Name: Ochanoko
Hours: Weekdays 11:00–19:00, weekends and holidays 10:00–19:00 (last order 18:00); closed 3rd Wednesday in some months
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市小西町35-2 コトモール1F
Notes: Warabi mochi, walnut mochi (kurumi mochi) and shaved ice, plus Taiwanese leicha tea. Easy to fit in between temples.

Name: Nakanishi Yosaburo
Hours: 10:00–18:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays (tea room Rokubo-an 11:00–17:30)
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市脇戸町23
Notes: A teahouse in an old townhouse, serving hot grilled mochi, wagashi and shaved ice.

Name: Housekibako
Hours: Weekdays 10:00–17:00, weekends and holidays 10:00–17:30; closed Thursdays; sometimes a midday break
Address (JA): 奈良県奈良市餅飯殿町47
Notes: Nara's most famous kakigori, served year-round: espuma toppings, matcha milk with rice crackers, and persimmon and plum in autumn. Hours change, so check the Instagram before you go.

Name: Nakamura Tokichi
Hours: Tea room 10:00–17:30 (last order 16:30)
Address (JA): 京都府宇治市宇治壱番10
Notes: Tea merchant since 1854; matcha jelly in a bamboo cup, matcha parfaits, matcha warabi mochi.

Name: Tsujiri Honten
Hours: Shop 10:00–18:00; tea room 11:00–17:30 (last order 17:00); closed Wed (Apr–Nov) or Tue and Wed (Dec–Mar)
Address (JA): 京都府宇治市宇治妙楽156
Notes: The original store of the Kyoto matcha brand; in summer, get the parfait with warabi mochi and azuki. Don't confuse it with Tsujiribei Honten, a separate company also in Uji.

Name: Chez Agata
Hours: Closed Wednesdays and Thursdays
Address (JA): 京都府宇治市菟道谷下り44-11
Notes: A small takeout-only shop doing cakes and chocolate alongside wagashi, and a pioneer of matcha terrine: the closest thing to a matcha-French patisserie in Uji. It's three minutes from Mimuroto Station, away from central Uji.

Name: Uso to Boku (Lies and I)
Address (JA): 京都府宇治市折居台3-2-183
Notes: Artistic, sculptural kakigori at one of Uji's popular dessert cafés. Seats go by reserved time slot, posted on its Instagram; it's in a residential area away from central Uji.

Name: Amazake Chaya
Hours: 7:00–17:30 (last order 17:00); open daily
Address (JA): 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町畑宿二子山395-28
Notes: ~400-year-old thatched teahouse run by the 13th generation; amazake and grilled chikara mochi (kinako or isobe nori). Good after hiking the old stone road.

Name: Chimoto
Branch: Ekimae-dori (address found); Honten is on Taki-dori, address not found
Hours: 9:00–17:00; irregular closed days; sells out early
Address (JA): 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町湯本690
Notes: Yumochi: soft mochi with bits of yokan and a hint of yuzu. The classic Hakone gift sweet.

Name: Salon de Thé Rosage
Hours: 10:00–17:00 (last order 16:00); occasional closures and a winter closure
Address (JA): 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町元箱根80
Notes: Hot apple pie and tea by the lake; a relaxing stop after the ropeway and boat loop.
